title: Commutativity via Spectral Equivalences of the Jordan Product in Banach Algebras
summary: Spectral characterizations of algebraic structure have a long history in the theory of Banach algebras. It is known that weak spectral information may force strong algebraic consequences, such as commutativity throughout the algebra or centrality of a single element. In this paper we study when spectral invariance, applied to the Jordan product $x \circ y = (xy + yx)/2$, forces commutativity or centrality in a semisimple Banach algebra $A$.
